fairness_rule: never compare our SELECTED top-k against a baseline's ALL-SAMPLE rate. Both arms are scored per-sample over their own returned candidates; the inspected-set ceiling is reported separately and marked NOT COMPARABLE.

comparison_1_same_returned_k.question: benchmark compatibility: at the same number of RETURNED candidates, how often is the benchmark solved?
comparison_1_same_returned_k.unmatched_axis: INSPECTED WORK is not matched and differs by roughly 14.4x in arm A's favour (distinct molecules property-evaluated per source)
comparison_1_same_returned_k.unit_of_success: a source counts as solved if any RETURNED molecule has QED >= 0.9 and Tanimoto >= 0.4 to the ORIGINAL source (Morgan r=2, 2048 bits)

dedicated_task.sampling: systematic sample of the 800-source panel (every 16th index), an unbiased estimator of the panel rate; arm A's comparator is its GLOBAL measured rate because its per-source records are on the Modal volume and no local copy exists

comparison_2_same_inspected_work.question: the algorithmic question: at comparable INSPECTED WORK, how often is the benchmark solved?
comparison_2_same_inspected_work.why_this_unit: primitive transitions, endpoint evaluations, distinct molecules and CPU seconds are different quantities. Arm A reports 6,755,513 proposed TRANSITIONS and 3,761,470 UNIQUE STATES over 798 sources -- a 1.80x difference between the two units on the same run -- so the unit must be named or the comparison is meaningless.
comparison_2_same_inspected_work.unit_ambiguity_in_arm_a: arm A's 3,761,470 figure is recorded as UNIQUE STATES. Whether that de-duplicates to distinct CANONICAL MOLECULES is not established here -- the per-source records are on the Modal volume and no local copy exists, and a Modal read was not performed. If 'states' counts padded graph objects rather than canonical molecules, arm A's per-source work is OVERSTATED by the duplication factor and the work ratios below move in arm A's favour. Treat the ratio as an upper bound on arm A's inspection cost until a record is read.
comparison_2_same_inspected_work.residual_unit_asymmetry: arm A property-evaluates every state along an SMC trajectory, including intermediates; this arm property-evaluates program ENDPOINTS only. Both counts are molecules whose QED and similarity were computed, so the unit is comparable, but arm A's total includes trajectory intermediates that have no analogue here.

by_charged_budget.success: any of the top-8 by score among the first C charged endpoints satisfies QED >= 0.9 and similarity >= 0.4
by_charged_budget.caveat: POST-HOC TRUNCATION of a single budget-48 run, not a set of independent budget-C runs. Parent selection depends on the observations already made, so a genuine budget-C run would explore differently; read this as an anytime profile of THIS run, not as a budget ablation.

by_inspected_molecules.success: a benchmark-solving molecule appeared ANYWHERE in the inspected prefix
by_inspected_molecules.why_not: this is an all-sample quantity; comparing it against a baseline's returned-candidate rate is exactly the unfairness the per-sample rule forbids. It bounds what the search reached, not what it returned.

bracketing.note: NO CELL MATCHES ON BOTH AXES. These two comparisons bracket the truth.

cheaper_arm_a_point.reading: we use 0.55x the work and return 8x the candidates

equal_k_arm_a_point.reading: same returned count; we use 0.069x the work

dedicated_task_metrics.per_sample_note: successful RETURNED slots divided by k*sources; unfilled slots count as failures, matching arm A's treatment of extinct trajectories. The selected top-k is never compared against a baseline all-sample rate.
dedicated_task_metrics.any_inspected_note: CEILING, NOT COMPARABLE to arm A's 446/800: it asks whether a solution appeared anywhere in the inspected set, which is an all-sample quantity, not a returned-candidate quantity

work_units_per_source.primitive_transitions_status: INFERRED -- executed endpoints times mean primitive depth of retained programs; per-attempt depth is not recorded

difficulty_structure.reading: success tracks how close the source already is to the region and how small it is. The search lands a median 0.07 short on the sources it misses, which is the signature of an under-budgeted search rather than a misdirected one -- and the charged-budget anytime curve is still rising at the budget cap.
difficulty_structure.caveat: these splits are post-hoc on 50 sources and are descriptive, not tested.

griddd_comparator.why: no PDF or programmatic extraction is present in this tree; every in-repo copy descends from one hand transcription, so their agreement is not independent corroboration
griddd_comparator.panel_comparability: NOT PANEL-MATCHED. GrIDDD selects its own 800 by shuffling ZINC-250k with pandas random_state=42, taking the final 10% test split, and keeping the first 800 processed rows with QED in 0.70-0.80. The reconstruction has canonical_set_intersection = 1 against Jin's exact 800. Both draw from the same ZINC-250k QED-in-[0.7,0.8] population, so the comparison is POPULATION-matched, not PANEL-matched.

claim_discipline: Do not state an unqualified 'COMPOSE beats GrIDDD'. The 446/800 result stands and is independently re-derived, but GrIDDD's 45.1% is UNVERIFIED at source and is measured on a panel sharing ONE molecule with Jin's 800.

independent_recomputation.method: recompute QED and Morgan-Tanimoto from the stored SMILES against the panel source read independently from data/jin/qed_test.txt
independent_recomputation.expected_initialization_delta: records written before the runner fix stored qed/sim as 0.0 for the INITIALIZATION row, because that endpoint is charged through the ledger without ever passing through the endpoint evaluator. deltas_by_role isolates it: candidate rows must agree to 0.0. Metrics are computed from the recomputation, so the artifact does not propagate.
